text: Create two protection zones lasting 1 hour for yourself: after eating and before sleep. During this time, do not open social networks, do not watch movies, do not read news... After eating — because during digestion the psyche plunges into a euphoric trance state and is very hypnotizable. At this time, anxious news penetrates deeply into the subconscious, and Hollywood clichés from films and the primitive values bandied about in social networks plunge you into the corresponding “reality.” And the time before sleep determines where you move at night, in what states you may flounder even without realizing what is happening. Therefore at this time, stay in silence, in contemplation, in prayer. If inner dialogues do not leave you, then at least direct the course of thought toward the higher meanings and values of life.
